CAMPPlus speaker embedding model for Chinese speech. It accepts 16 kHz speech and returns a 192-dimensional speaker identity vector for verification and identification.
MiniMax-Music3 generates complete songs from lyrics and a music description. The model is distributed under the MiniMax-Music3 Community License and requires NVIDIA CUDA for inference.
FireRedTTS3 Base supports multilingual zero-shot voice cloning with reference audio and text.
FireRedTTS3 Instruct supports natural-language voice design and zero-shot voice cloning.
ACE-Step 1.5 generates complete songs from lyrics and a music description. The default integration uses the bundled turbo DiT model and supports optional 5Hz LM reasoning.
